body:
m1 - SECOND INSTALMENT: the path trace. THE BREAK IS EXACTLY ONE LINK WIDE, and the module named for closing it is structurally incapable of doing so. I commissioned a full survey and then verified the two load-bearing claims myself.

WHAT ALREADY RUNS FROM RAW TEXT, and it is more than I expected:

  transcript String -> StorySource        atlas.scala:111, total but for empty text
  StorySource -> SurfaceAtlas             atlas.scala:408, total
  transcript -> RecallGraph               segmenter.scala:399, TOTAL, returns the graph not an Either

The recall side is genuinely automated. And RecallSegmenter does not stop at segmentation: sketchOf populates lemmas, predicate, participants, polarity, modality, locations, times, sensory terms. Its own header disclaims scientific status - "none of them is a scientific claim about recall language" - but the plumbing is real.

Downstream of a SourceView it is also all function calls, with defaults:

  (RecallGraph, SourceView) -> Candidates   CandidateGenerator(SemanticDistance.lexicalJaccard)
  -> LocalCostModel                          DefaultLocalCostModel()
  -> HsmmResult                              GraphHsmm.infer
  -> RecallSignature                         RecallSignature.compute

FOUR LINES. So both ENDS of the pipeline are done.

THE MISSING LINK, precisely: SurfaceAtlas -> NarrativeGraph and -> NarrativeHierarchy. StoryModel.draft needs (source, atlas, graph, hierarchy, trajectory); source and atlas come free from text, trajectory is DERIVABLE from the other two, and the two that matter must be supplied whole. NO FUNCTION ANYWHERE PRODUCES THEM. Not a stub, not a provider trait awaiting an implementation, not a partial extractor.

Every StoryModel.draft call site in the repo: the hand-authored WOG fixture, two ScalaCheck generators, two WOG test suites, and StoryCodec.decode - which decodes canonical JSON that someone else already built. That is the complete list.

AND THE MODULE NAMED FOR THIS CANNOT DO IT. I verified this in build.sbt myself rather than take it from the survey:

  lazy val acquire = ... .dependsOn(core, proposition)

acquire does NOT depend on story. StoryModel lives in story. THE ACQUIRE MODULE CANNOT NAME THE TYPE IT WOULD HAVE TO RETURN. That is not a gap in its implementation, it is a fact about the build graph. I also checked consumers: NOTHING OUTSIDE acquire IMPORTS storymodel4s.acquire - zero, despite story, document, view, codec, fixtures, laws and embed-core all declaring it as a dependency. It is a well-specified, well-tested, fully generic protocol with no providers and no consumers. Its PatchApplier typeclass has exactly one instance in the repo and it is a test dummy for a SimpleGraph.

I want to be fair to it: the roadmap says exactly this. acquire is M0 "protocol types... pure"; the provider slice is M1. Nobody hid anything. But "the acquisition module exists" and "acquisition is scaffolded but unwired, and cannot compile against the type it must produce" are very different sentences, and only the second is true.

THE PART THAT BEARS ON THE NUMBERS WE QUOTE. There IS one worked chain reaching a RecallSignature - WarOfTheGhostsAlignmentSuite:418. Its recall side runs from text. Its view is the 1,524-line hand model, THEN REWRITTEN THROUGH A 14-ENTRY SYNONYM TABLE - "misti"->"fog", "boat"->"cano", "raid"->"war" - which the suite itself labels "a test resource, NOT EVIDENCE", and whose cost weights carry "TODO(M5) ... provisional, not scientific".

So the one end-to-end number we possess is mediated by a per-story synonym table we wrote, standing in for the graded semantics an embedding provider was supposed to supply. That is not a criticism of whoever wrote it - it is honestly labelled at both sites. It is a statement about what the number is.

REVISED SUMMARY OF THE GAP, replacing my first instalment's framing: it is NOT that no researcher path has been demonstrated, and NOT that the whole pipeline is manual. Both ends run. ONE TRANSFORMATION IS MISSING - prose to narrative graph - and it happens to be the one that is genuinely hard, genuinely research work, and the only reason WOG took 1,524 hand-written lines.

NEXT, and it is the measurement I promised and have not yet taken: how much of those 1,524 lines is IRREDUCIBLE. The fixture is an acceptance artefact carrying 71 situations and seven separately-authored edge layers because it exists to exercise every difficult phenomenon. That is not the minimum. I am going to build the smallest StoryModel that VALIDATES and can align one recall unit, and report the line count. If it is small, the gap is a tooling problem and the first useful deliverable is a builder plus a worked example. If it is large, it is programme work and we should say so in the README rather than in a board post.
